sandshrew-take-down.name: Take Down
sandshrew-take-down.description: Bond skill: a reckless charge hitting foes in a 3-hex line (Power 60).

sandshrew-crush-claw.name: Crush Claw
sandshrew-crush-claw.description: Bond skill: tears into a foe (Power 85, Attack), leaving it Exposed for 2 turns.

sandshrew-rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
sandshrew-rapid-spin.description: Bond skill: a spinning strike (Power 50, Attack) that frees it from engagement.

sandshrew-sand-veil.name: Sand Veil
sandshrew-sand-veil.description: Sand clings to its hide and blurs it: takes 10% less damage.

sandshrew-sharp-claws.name: Sharp Claws
sandshrew-sharp-claws.description: Deals 15% more damage to adjacent foes.

sandshrew-sand-tomb.name: Sand Tomb
sandshrew-sand-tomb.description: New skill: traps a foe up to 2 hexes away in whirling sand (Power 35), Slowing it for 2 turns.

sandshrew-metal-claw.name: Metal Claw
sandshrew-metal-claw.description: New skill: a quick, steel-hard claw (Power 50).

sandshrew-spiked-back.name: Spiked Back
sandshrew-spiked-back.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 8 damage from its spikes.

sandshrew-sand-force.name: Sand Force
sandshrew-sand-force.description: Its Ground moves deal 15% more damage; deals 20% more to foes standing on mud.

sandshrew-swords-dance.name: Swords Dance
sandshrew-swords-dance.description: New skill: a frenzied war dance that makes it Focused for 2 turns.

sandshrew-poison-sting.name: Poison Sting
sandshrew-poison-sting.description: New skill: a venomous jab (Power 45) that Poisons the foe for 2 turns.

sandshrew-burrowed-stance.name: Burrowed Stance
sandshrew-burrowed-stance.description: Heals 4% of its max HP each turn while engaged with a foe.

sandshrew-relentless-claws.name: Relentless Claws
sandshrew-relentless-claws.description: Each hit in a row on the same foe deals 15% more damage (up to 3 stacks).

sandshrew-drill-run.name: Drill Run
sandshrew-drill-run.description: New skill: spins like a drill through a 2-hex line (Power 80).

sandshrew-magnitude.name: Magnitude
sandshrew-magnitude.description: New skill: a tremor that hits foes within 1 hex (Power 70).

sandshrew-dig-out.name: Dig Out
sandshrew-dig-out.description: Burrows away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

sandshrew-curled-tight.name: Curled Tight
sandshrew-curled-tight.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

sandshrew-high-horsepower.name: High Horsepower
sandshrew-high-horsepower.description: New skill: a crushing stomp on an adjacent foe (Power 95).

sandshrew-swift.name: Swift
sandshrew-swift.description: New skill: star-shaped rays hit every foe within 2 hexes (Power 50).

sandshrew-ambush-from-below.name: Ambush from Below
sandshrew-ambush-from-below.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

sandshrew-rolled-shell.name: Rolled Shell
sandshrew-rolled-shell.description: Takes 25% less damage while at full HP.

sandshrew-desert-fortress.name: Desert Fortress
sandshrew-desert-fortress.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage; foes engaged with it always draw its free strike when leaving.

sandshrew-sandslash-frenzy.name: Sandslash Frenzy
sandshrew-sandslash-frenzy.description: Capstone. Each knockout gives 1 Bond, heals 15% of max HP and lets it basic attack again.
